title: Day 89: CJNG Intensifies War on Nahua Indigenous Communities in Michoacán — Nigeria NDLEA Busts CJNG-Linked Meth Superlab; El Sapo Hunt Day 89; Plan Kukulkan 20 Days
detail: Day 89 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). CJNG ESCALATION IN MICHOACÁN — NAHUA INDIGENOUS COMMUNITIES (May 22, 2026): La Jornada reported today ('Arrecian ataques del CJNG contra comunidades nahuas de Michoacan') that CJNG has intensified armed attacks against indigenous Nahua communities in the municipality of Aquila, Michoacán — particularly La Cofradía and Ostula. Between May 19–21 alone, La Cofradía was attacked three times: a sustained hour-long assault on the community guard post on May 19 beginning at 9:00 AM, and a second armed incursion repelled on May 21 at 6:20 AM. The community's Guardia Comunal repelled both incidents. In less than 18 months, La Cofradía has been attacked seven times total. Community authorities documented 42 homicides and 5 disappearances attributed to CJNG operations in the area and issued urgent demands for federal military deployment. The CNI (National Indigenous Congress) has recorded dozens of armed incursions, drone attacks, and explosive devices against civilian infrastructure over the past two years in the Aquila coastal corridor — a critical CJNG supply route linking Tierra Caliente to the Pacific coast. The ongoing attack pattern demonstrates CJNG's continued operational capacity in coastal Michoacán despite 89 days of post-Mencho decapitation pressure. NIGERIA NDLEA METH SUPERLAB BUST — CJNG AFRICA EXPANSION (May 16–22, 2026): Nigeria's National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA) raided a clandestine forest methamphetamine laboratory in Ogun State on May 16, arresting three Mexican nationals identified as cooks — Martinez Felix Nemecto, Jesus Lopez Valles, and Torrero Juan Carlos. Seized: 2,419.48 kg of methamphetamine plus chemical materials with a market value of approximately $362.9 million (N480 billion). The Washington Times (May 21) and Arise News reported the DEA has linked the operation to CJNG/Sinaloa franchise networks using Africa to exploit regulatory environments and use the continent as a transshipment hub. This follows the South Africa Swarttruggens lab bust (May 13: 481 kg seized, 11 arrested including 5 Mexican nationals) and confirms the multi-country Africa meth manufacturing network documented in U.S. AFRICOM's Congressional testimony (May 20). The CJNG–Nigeria bust adds West Africa as a confirmed third geographic node in the cartel's Africa expansion (alongside South Africa and potentially other East African routes), all documented in the span of one week. Together with the Chile meth operation (May 17: 35-year sentences sought for 844kg for Australian distribution), CJNG's transnational manufacturing arc now spans South America + West Africa + Southern Africa — entirely independent of the Manzanillo/Jalisco fentanyl core and resilient to the 89-day decapitation campaign. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 89 (NO CAPTURE): Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet top-priority CJNG enforcement target. No confirmed operation, arrest, or elimination on Day 89. PLAN KUKULKAN — 20 DAYS: Twenty days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City). Guadalajara's Akron Stadium hosts four group-stage matches. CJNG's ongoing attacks on Nahua communities in Michoacán — just days before the World Cup — intensify international scrutiny of Mexico's security claims. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 13: Thirteen days since El Chucky's arrest (May 9) with no confirmed successor plaza boss. LAGOS DE MORENO CREMATORIO (ONGOING): FGE Jalisco forensics continue — no official victim count. DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 89: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate regional (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 47+ confirmed CJNG HVTs neutralized. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION — DAY 89: Ongoing.
